description: Stratified ice-on-coil TES. Ice forms from bottom upward (cold glycol coils at base); discharge melts ice from top down (warm return contacts upper ice surface). Multi-node vertical stratification + heat loss through tank walls.

unit.name: Generic 500 kWh_th stratified ice-on-coil TES with 8 vertical nodes
unit.source: ASHRAE (2020) HVAC Systems ch.51; Dincer & Rosen (2021) Thermal Energy Storage, 3rd ed., Wiley; MacPhee, D., Dincer, I. (2009). Int. J. Heat Mass Transfer 52, 1753-1762; Jekel, T.B. et al. (1993). ASHRAE Trans. 99, 1016-1024.

UA_loss.note: Total heat-loss UA (tank walls + lid + floor)

N_nodes.note: Vertical nodes; node 1=bottom (coldest during charging), node N=top

k_axial.note: Effective axial thermal conductance between adjacent nodes (conduction through ice + water layer); MacPhee & Dincer (2009)

charge_effectiveness.note: Heat-transfer effectiveness of coil during charging (fraction of theoretical freezing rate achieved)

discharge_effectiveness.note: Melt effectiveness on discharge; slightly lower due to ice-water film resistance — Jekel et al. (1993)
